BrowserApp.description: A browser application: an authorization-code client with PKCE.

clientProfile.description:
Optional client behavior. When omitted, the client remains
authorization-code-only with only its origin as a logout return.
`python-portal` also admits refresh grants and same-origin `/auth/login`.

logoUrl.description: A public logo URL, shown on the sign-in page; omitted shows none.

product.description:
The `product` whose audience tokens carry by default. A request still
produces a token for one audience.

tokenAttributes.description:
Claims the application's tokens carry from the signed-in user. Each
is declared by a product or by an extension user type this application
explicitly admits. A product declaration remains authoritative.

userTypes.description:
Extension user types (ids of `userTypes`) that may sign in, beside
the generated `RegistryPerson`.

oneOf.description:
A confidential Python portal using authorization code with PKCE and
rotating refresh tokens for one requested resource. It also registers
same-origin `/auth/login` for an account-switch logout return.

Client.description:
A machine client: authenticates with `private_key_jwt` against its own
public key set.

claims.description:
Static claims the issuer puts in the client's tokens; each name and
type must be one a product declares.

publicJwksFile.description: A JWKS file holding public keys only, relative to this file.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

Grant.description: Access profiles of one product, granted to one principal.

accessProfiles.description: Ids of that product's access profiles.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

OrganizationUnit.description:
The organization unit every generated resource belongs to. The handle
`default` builds on the unit the bootstrap bundle creates.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

User.description: A user, with the claims their tokens carry stated explicitly.

claims.description:
Product claims, plus scalar issuer-owned attributes declared by this
user's exact extension type. `RegistryPerson` has no such extension.

userType.description: An extension user type (id of `userTypes`); omitted is `RegistryPerson`.

UserType.description: An extension user type: an additional ThunderID user schema.

attributes.description:
Optional issuer-owned string attributes beyond username, email and
password. They grant no product authority. A user may carry one only
through this exact type, and an application may project one only when
it explicitly admits a type that declares it. Product claim types and
selectors remain authoritative where a product declares the same name.

name.description: The ThunderID type name users of this type carry.
